amendments.currentBlockSession: B2 / W16 Duties 1 / 2: Intake plus Inspection
amendments.whatIsMissing: Automotive industry context; autocare technician role; limits of autonomy; reporting channels
amendments.proposedTitle: Intake, technician role boundaries, and inspection planning
amendments.proposedAmendment: Keep original intake/inspection content. ADD ~45–60 min taught+applied opener on Autocare technician role in the industry, limits of autonomy, and reporting channels. Shorten generic intake role-play accordingly. Learner must escalate vs overstep in scenarios and record referrals.
amendments.whyInsufficient: Current W16 is intake/comms and inspection planning from symptoms only; no role/autonomy/reporting teaching.
amendments.whyClosesGap: Creates explicit teach+apply evidence for K1 before intake commitments.
amendments.changeTypes: amended teaching content; added activity; added assessment/evidence; optional title tweak
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K1 — Primary home B2 after adoption):
1) Teach: automotive industry context; role of the autocare technician; limits of autonomy; reporting channels.
2) Apply: 2 intake scenarios where learner decides what they may confirm alone vs must escalate (supervisor/service adviser).
3) Evidence: role/reporting map worksheet + observation checklist + job-card referral note.
Retain existing intake→inspection planning practical (also hosts Group 4 proposal).

amendments.whatIsMissing: Explicit EDI principles; complying with EDI guidance; inclusive workplace behaviour (respect for different views)
amendments.proposedAmendment: Keep existing complaint-handling content. ADD concise EDI principles (K31) and organisational EDI guidance (S20). Reshape at least one role-play to require inclusive practice (B5). Require written record to cite EDI guidance applied.
amendments.whyInsufficient: Focus list names B5/K31/S20 but session is generic complaint handling with no EDI teaching.
amendments.whyClosesGap: One amended people session can evidence knowledge + skill + behaviour for the EDI cluster.
amendments.changeTypes: amended teaching content; added activity; added assessment/evidence
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (B5/K31/S20 — Primary home B2 after adoption):
1) Teach K31: EDI principles and workplace impact (short input).
2) Teach/apply S20: organisational EDI guidance learners must follow.
3) Apply B5: inclusive role-play (language barrier / accessibility / respectful disagreement).
4) Evidence: EDI knowledge check + observed role-play criteria + interaction record citing guidance.
Preserve original complaint/delay scenarios as remaining practice.

amendments.currentBlockSession: B3 / W26 Workshop procedures, documentation control and handover discipline
amendments.whatIsMissing: Workplace instructions as an object of learning for inspection/maintenance/replacement
amendments.originalTitle: Workshop procedures, documentation control and handover discipline
amendments.proposedTitle: Workplace instructions, documentation control and handover discipline
amendments.proposedAmendment: Keep job-card quality focus. ADD explicit teaching of workplace instructions (SOP/method statement/manufacturer workshop instructions) vs job cards. Practical: select correct instruction for an inspect/maintain/replace task, extract steps, then complete job card referencing instruction ID/version.
amendments.whyInsufficient: K7 on focus list; content is job-card lifecycle only.
amendments.whyClosesGap: Learners must locate, interpret and apply workplace instructions to real task types.
amendments.reinforcement: B2 W16 (after Group 4); B5 process weeks
amendments.changeTypes: amended objective; amended teaching content; added practical; added assessment/evidence
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K7 — Primary home B3 after adoption):
1) Distinguish workplace instructions from job cards/customer notes.
2) Practical: for inspect OR maintain OR replace task, choose the correct instruction and annotate mandatory steps/controls.
3) Complete job card referencing instruction ID/version used.
4) Evidence: annotated instruction + referenced job card + oral check on purpose of instructions.
Retain shortened original job-card error-correction activity.

amendments.currentBlockSession: B2 / W16 Duties 1 / 2: Intake plus Inspection
amendments.whatIsMissing: Manufacturer/approved schedules; vehicle-specific data; legal wear/serviceability; apply inspection/routine maintenance using that data
amendments.proposedTitle: Intake, technician role boundaries, and inspection-to-spec
amendments.proposedAmendment: Shared host with Group 1. Convert inspection-planning activity into schedule/data-led safety inspection / routine maintenance practical. Learners look up schedule & vehicle-specific data, measure against wear/serviceability limits, record pass/advise/fail.
amendments.whyInsufficient: Inspection planning is symptom-led from customer concerns, not manufacturer data/schedule-led.
amendments.whyClosesGap: Creates explicit K2 knowledge use and S7 applied procedure with vehicle-specific data.
amendments.reinforcement: B3 W24 wear limits (reinforcement only); B10 consolidation
amendments.changeTypes: amended teaching content; added practical; added assessment/evidence
amendments.otjImpact: 0 additional OTJ — shared 5.5h restructure with Group 1 on W16
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K2/S7 — Primary home B2 after adoption; same session as Group 1):
1) Teach K2: approved schedules, vehicle-specific data sources, legal wear/serviceability requirements.
2) Practical S7: perform defined inspection/routine maintenance checks using looked-up data for a specific vehicle.
3) Record measured values vs limits with pass/advise/fail judgement.
4) Evidence: schedule/data reference + completed checklist + observation of procedure.
Do not claim coverage from intake role-play alone.

amendments.whatIsMissing: Systems knowledge for brake fluid, oil/oil filters, air filters; check and replace fluids and filtration parts
amendments.proposedTitle: Engine service systems: fluids, filtration and related mechanical checks
amendments.proposedAmendment: Preserve a shorter engine mechanical context. REPLACE deep fault-diagnosis focus with explicit K20 systems teaching and mandatory S25 practical: check fluid condition/levels; replace/simulate oil + oil filter; inspect/replace air filter; check brake fluid to procedure. Must cover fluids AND filtration.
amendments.whyInsufficient: Current W13 is mechanical engine ID/fault scenarios; fluids appear elsewhere only as hazardous waste types (W30).
amendments.whyClosesGap: Dedicated systems+practical evidence for fluids and filtration components/procedures.
amendments.reinforcement: B3 W30 disposal awareness only; B10 consolidation
amendments.changeTypes: amended title; amended teaching content; added practical; added assessment/evidence
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K20/S25 — Primary home B2 after adoption):
1) Teach K20: purpose/location of engine oil + oil filter, air filter, brake fluid; contamination indicators.
2) Practical S25 (required gate): check fluids; replace/simulate oil+oil filter; replace/inspect air filter; check brake fluid to procedure.
3) Evidence: location/knowledge check + observed practical checklist + service record of checks/replacements.
SUFFICIENCY GATE: practical must include fluids AND filtration parts — not leak visuals alone.
Retain abbreviated engine mechanical relevance only.

amendments.currentBlockSession: B5 / W43 Complex repairs, time management and QA sign-off (proposed host)
amendments.whatIsMissing: Purpose/function/location of emission control systems (catalytic, EVAP, EGR, DPF, PPF, SCR)
amendments.originalTitle: Complex repairs, time management and QA sign-off
amendments.proposedTitle: Complex repairs with emission-system identification, time management and QA sign-off
amendments.proposedAmendment: Keep planning/QA content. ADD taught emission-system identification (purpose/function/location) and a locate/identify practical on training vehicle/rig for catalytic/EVAP/EGR/DPF/PPF/SCR as applicable. Reduce generic time-management discussion proportionately.
amendments.whyInsufficient: No session currently teaches emission control systems; proximity to suspension/inspection is not evidence.
amendments.whyClosesGap: Creates explicit K13 knowledge with locate/identify application in a systems/complex-repair block.
amendments.reinforcement: B2/B10 systems consolidation if later revisited
amendments.changeTypes: amended teaching content; added practical; added assessment/evidence
amendments.otjImpact: 0 additional OTJ — restructure within existing 5.5h (preferred). New session only if Jon rejects restructuring W43.
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K13 — Primary home B5 after adoption):
1) Teach purpose/function/location of emission control systems listed in official K13.
2) Practical: locate/identify components on vehicle/diagram; explain inspection/removal/replacement considerations at awareness/technician scope.
3) Evidence: component ID sheet + oral/written purpose check.
Retain shortened complex-repair planning/QA content.

amendments.currentBlockSession: B5 / W45 VIN lookup, technical data and parts availability checks
amendments.whatIsMissing: Digital technology systems; GDPR; cyber security; using information/digital systems compliantly
amendments.originalTitle: VIN lookup, technical data and parts availability checks
amendments.proposedTitle: VIN lookup, digital workshop systems, GDPR and cyber-secure practice
amendments.proposedAmendment: Keep VIN/catalogue practical. ADD explicit teaching of workshop digital systems (K34) and GDPR/cyber requirements (K34/S23). Require learners to complete data lookup while demonstrating secure handling (screen lock, need-to-know customer data, no unauthorised sharing).
amendments.whyInsufficient: Uses digital catalogues but does not teach digital systems inventory or GDPR/cyber compliance. Stock-security wording elsewhere is a false friend.
amendments.whyClosesGap: Same session becomes Primary home for digital systems use + compliance.
amendments.reinforcement: B6 W56 records/compliance; B10 portfolio digital evidence
amendments.changeTypes: amended teaching content; added activity; added assessment/evidence
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K34/S23 — Primary home B5 after adoption):
1) Teach K34: workshop digital systems (email/collaboration/databases/MIS/POS/equipment interfaces) + GDPR + cyber basics.
2) Apply S23: use VIN/data/catalogue systems while complying with GDPR/cyber controls.
3) Evidence: system-use checklist + GDPR/cyber short scenario responses + completed parts lookup record.
Do NOT use stock-security language as substitute evidence.

amendments.currentBlockSession: B9 / W89 Pre-calibration checks: alignment, ride height and sensor inputs
amendments.whatIsMissing: ADAS levels of autonomy; passive vs active ADAS
amendments.originalTitle: Pre-calibration checks: alignment, ride height and sensor inputs
amendments.proposedTitle: ADAS autonomy levels and pre-calibration readiness checks
amendments.proposedAmendment: Keep pre-calibration mechanical/sensor readiness content. ADD explicit taught section on ADAS levels of autonomy and passive vs active systems with examples, then link why pre-checks matter before ADAS work.
amendments.whyInsufficient: W89 covers ADAS-related pre-calibration readiness, not levels of autonomy (passive/active).
amendments.whyClosesGap: Adds the missing K18 knowledge object while retaining existing pre-check practical.
amendments.reinforcement: B9 W90 readiness case studies; B10 consolidation
proposedSection: PROPOSED ADDITION (K18 — Primary home B9 after adoption):
1) Teach ADAS levels of autonomy; distinguish passive vs active systems with examples.
2) Link to existing pre-calibration checks (why sensor/geometry readiness matters).
3) Evidence: short knowledge check on levels/passive/active + retain pre-check practical evidence.
Pre-calibration alone remains insufficient without this addition.
